name: Hierarchical 3D Sampling
definition: A sampling method creating a series of points in a unit cube where any subset of the first n points is evenly distributed with uniform density and minimum distance between points. The serial number k of point Pk is the priority number (smaller k = higher priority). Used for density control and level-of-detail management in volume rendering.
summary: Hierarchical 3D Sampling generates deterministic, ordered point sets for volume rendering, distinguishing itself from probabilistic methods by defining point priority via generation sequence index.
